title: See which stories a Plan intends to deliver
statement: As a product manager, I can see which user stories a Plan intends to deliver, and reach the Plan from those stories and their Roadmap feature, so I can check that the proposed approach serves the intent I wrote down.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Plan's page lists the stories it intends to deliver, each with its current title and lifecycle state.
A reader on one of those stories, or on its Roadmap feature's page, can follow a link to the Plan.
After feature deliver moves the stories into the feature they extend, the Plan still lists them and they still link back to it.
When a story's wording changes after a Plan linked it, the Plan shows that link as stale until its author repins it.
